title: Juan Franco
text:
I turn operational data into decisions. At Royal Caribbean Group I analyze fleet deployment and itinerary planning, and I’m completing a master’s degree in Business Analytics at Boston University.
This site brings together projects I’ve built in school and at work, with a focus on data engineering, cloud analytics and machine learning.
View my projects Download my CV Get in touch

title: About
text: I’m a data analyst based in Miami, working in the cruise industry. At Royal Caribbean Group I work on fleet deployment and itinerary planning, where a single schedule change can affect ports, fuel, crew and guests at the same time. Most of my day is spent pulling that information together in SQL, Python, Excel and Power BI so the team can see the trade-offs clearly before making a call.

title: About
text:
How I got here
I started with a bachelor’s degree in finance from Florida International University, which gave me a solid base in financial modeling and economics. Before the cruise industry, I worked at Parkland, where I built KPI reports, ran root cause analysis on operational problems and helped develop pricing strategies. I then moved to Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings, working on deployment and revenue analysis and building Tableau dashboards that revenue and strategy teams used every week. That work led me to my current role at Royal Caribbean Group.

title: About
text:
What I’m working toward
My goal is to move into data science and machine learning roles. Much of the analysis I do today explains what happened and why. I want to get better at the predictive side: building models that forecast demand, flag risks early and help teams plan ahead instead of reacting. The master’s program at Boston University has given me hands-on practice with classification models, Apache Spark, cloud computing on AWS and generative AI, and I apply those skills to real problems whenever I can.

title: Projects
text:
A selection of academic and work projects. Course code stays private while classes are in session, and work projects are described without company data.




Career Evaluation Website
Team project · AD688 Big Data and Cloud Analytics · In progress
A Quarto website that helps analytics job seekers compare roles, salaries and skill demand in Computer Systems Design (NAICS 5415). I built the data pipeline that filters 504,208 raw job postings down to a 1,790-posting, 12-month panel, wrote the location and salary cleaning scripts (including a fix for Washington, DC postings being counted as Washington State), and wrote the project’s literature review.
Tools: Python, PySpark, pandas, AWS EC2, Quarto, GitHub Pages
Visit the team site





Job Market Analytics with Apache Spark
Individual coursework · AD688 Big Data and Cloud Analytics
Two analyses of a large job postings dataset, run on an AWS EC2 instance. The first models the data as a star schema in Spark SQL and answers four business questions about salaries and demand across industries and states. The second cleans the raw postings in PySpark, recovers years of experience from job description text when the structured fields were blank, and charts salary patterns by industry, education, experience and remote status.
Tools: PySpark, Spark SQL, Plotly, Quarto, AWS EC2







Zurich Airbnb Classification
Team project · AD699 Data Mining for Business Analytics
Classification models built on 2,534 Zurich listings from Inside Airbnb. A k-nearest neighbors model predicts whether a listing offers a dedicated workspace, with k chosen by 10-fold cross-validation (60.8% test accuracy against a 58.7% baseline). A pruned decision tree predicts how quickly hosts respond across four classes, reaching 73.9% test accuracy against a 61.9% baseline.
Tools: Python, scikit-learn, pandas, Jupyter







Weekly Planning File Consolidation
Work project · Royal Caribbean Group
A reusable Python script that combines ship-by-ship planning tabs into one clean dataset each week. It uses fuzzy matching to line up port names that are spelled differently across sources, so the combined file can be checked against the itinerary system of record.
Tools: Python, pandas, fuzzy string matching







Guest Satisfaction Dashboard
Work project · Royal Caribbean Group
A Power BI dashboard that tracks guest satisfaction scores, connected live to Databricks through DirectQuery. I built the data model, the DAX measures and the Power Query steps so the team can follow satisfaction results in one place without exporting data by hand.
Tools: Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Databricks
